description: NASA researchers and collaborators publish a landslide susceptibility map for the Arun River basin across Nepal and Tibet. They derived it with a random-forest method using a separate multitemporal landslide inventory. The Figshare version-one page lists a 19.92 MB ZIP containing a susceptibility TIFF and auxiliary files, and its public API states CC BY 4.0 with free access. A hydropower or river-corridor modeller can overlay this raster with planned assets to compare spatial exposure or prioritise more detailed slope analysis. The map is a modelled susceptibility surface, not an observed event record or a prediction of failure time. Its apparent precision should be checked against training data and local terrain before siting decisions; raster values and validation statistics were not inspected. It is related to the catalogue METEOR Nepal hazard maps but covers the particular Arun basin. The NASA inventory used to train it is a separate resource with an Earthdata login route.
